It's a Least Weasel. "Least weasel" is the most adorable name for an animal, ever.

My girlfriend and I were picking blueberries one morning. We both noticed a commotion. A group of Orioles were moving through the trees, from the bottom of the hill to us near the top. We waited. They were freaking out. We couldn't see what had them so upset. A moment later a weasel in its summer colors hopped up on a rock no more than five feet from us. It looked like the softest animal on the planet. Honest. Like you'd touch it and feel nothing. It stood there, surprised that we were there, bothered still by the Orioles, and then it zipped to its right and bounded away. The Orioles stayed on it and we went back to picking. Nice morning.
